Definition: Jechiel (or Jechavel), the name of eight Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehiel is the name of eight Israelites, spread across the singers, the princes, and the return. He is a singer of the second degree who carried the ark, a brother of the sons of Jehoshaphat, and the father of Obadiah who came up with Ezra.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God keeps eight men under one name, and the singer and the prince and the father are each remembered. My position is that the name is common but the men are not, and God knows which Jehiel He means.
RelatedPeople: Jehiel, Singer of Second Degree; Jehiel, Son of Jehoshaphat; Jehiel, Father of Obadiah
